thread:
maria: paging — alert flood from inference-prod: latency p95 jumped to ~1.2s for text-gen endpoints, errors creeping up. Noticed spike at 09:42 UTC. @oncall-engineer please take a look.
incident-bot: Incident created: INF-2026-236000 — High latency on streaming/text-gen. Pager escalation sent to @oncall-engineer.
aj: I'm on it, pulling metrics. Any customer reports?
maria: support flagged a couple of PLG accounts with timeouts, small but critical. Dashboard shows continuous batching queue growth and GPU utilization at 88% but host CPU at 96%.
sam: Repro on canary: when concurrency > 300 we start backpressure on mux and streaming frames get queued. Suspect push paths + KV cache churn.
leah: If we don't act we risk broader impact. Suggest temporary mitigation: disable streaming responses for public hosted API, switch to chunked polling fallback for 10m, and apply a global soft rate-limit for high-concurrency keys. Thoughts? :warning:
aj: Agree. Two-step: 1) soft quota bump to throttle aggressive clients (lock to 60rps per API key), 2) toggle streaming=false for the host-tier routing rule so clients get non-streaming chunks.
oncall-engineer: I'll execute the routing change. Informing comms and support.
sam: Share exact commands pls.
oncall-engineer: Running admin toggle: \n```\nPOST /admin/routing/feature-toggle\n{\n  "feature": "streaming_push",\n  "state": "off",\n  "scope": "hosted-public",\n  "reason": "mitigate queue/backpressure INF-2026-236000"\n}\n```\nleah: Also applying token-level soft rate limit: \n```\nPATCH /admin/quotas\n{ "selector": "*", "max_rps": 60, "duration_s": 600, "mode": "soft" }\n```\nsupport-bot: Notifying affected customers: creating incident notes and templated email draft.
maria: Executed streaming toggle and quota patch — pushing to edge in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Watching metrics.
aj: Metrics: mux queue depth dropping, GPU utilization stable at 76%, p95 latency back to ~420ms in 90s. Error rate decreased. Nice work.
sam: We should keep streaming off for 15 minutes and monitor for recurrence; if stable, roll back in stages to avoid oscillation.
leah: Agreed. Sam take point on rollback plan. Maria coordinate comms to customers and product. Aj continue watch and add traces for KV-churn patterns.
maria: Draft sent to #support and #product. Notifying the top-10 active keys we throttled.
incident-bot: Pager update: INF-2026-236000 status -> mitigation in progress; streaming disabled for hosted-public; soft rate limit applied.
sam: Follow-up: logs show a particular client library doing many short-lived streams that never finished, causing KV churn. We'll add a server-side idle timeout on incomplete streams in next patch.
leah: Postmortem owners: sam (root cause & runtime fix), aj (monitoring & alert tuning), maria (customer comms). Set follow-up meeting in 24h.
oncall-engineer: Rolling back streaming in a canary group now (10% of hosts) to verify behavior.
aj: Canary looks good, no queue rebuild. Gradually restore streaming over 20 minutes with throttling rules in place.
maria: Closing the active page now. Thanks team. Will attach logs and timeline to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
